newsitem.title: TAIWAN: FORECAST-Taiwan Jan industry output - Reuters poll.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Taiwan Jan industry output - Reuters poll.

text.p: The following Reuters poll of Taiwan economists gives their projections for year-on-year growth of the island's industrial output in January.
The official figures are due to be released by the economics ministry at 0230 GMT on February 20.
Industrial output rose 6.11 percent year-on-year in December.
The poll results produced an average forecast for an annual rise of 5.02 percent in industrial output in January.
Economists said they expected the island's industrial output to continue a recovery begun in July 1996.
"In addition to slow but stable growth in export orders received, we have strengthening domestic demand to fuel our January industrial output," said National Securities economist Lin Kuo-yang.
Terry Chen, vice-president of the research department at Grand Cathay Securities, said stocks of textile and machinery products were reducing, which would trigger increases in industrial output.
